theorems.name: Submission.cmr_df_extDeriv_smul_curryLeft
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (b : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ b x → DifferentiableAt ℝ G x → ∀ w : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y => b y • ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft θ (G y)) x w = ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (fderiv ℝ b x (w i) * θ (Fin.cons (G x) (i.removeNth w)) + b x * θ (Fin.cons (fderiv ℝ G x (w i)) (i.removeNth w)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
